results.note: The official bundestag.de roll-call page shows the Haushaltsgesetz 2027 (21/7300, 21/7302) passed in third reading on Fri 27 Nov 2026 with 316 yes, 260 no, 0 abstentions (630 members, 54 not voting) - exactly the 316 threshold.

second_opinion.note: Both models report 316 yes, matching the official roll-call page.

results.note: electionresults.govt.nz refused scripted reading (HTTP 403); RNZ's results page (Commission data, published 27 Nov 14:00 NZDT) and 1News (27 Nov) both report the official allocation National 40 + ACT 13 + NZ First 12 = 65 of 130 seats, exactly half.

second_opinion.note: Both models give 65 of 130, the same allocation RNZ and 1News report.

results.note: rheinmetall.com news-watch carries no CMD release, so two outlets decide: dpa-AFX (27 Nov 12:50Z) and Börsen-Zeitung (27 Nov) report a new 2030 sales target of EUR 33-37bn set at the Hamburg Capital Markets Day; midpoint 35bn is below 50bn.

second_opinion.note: Both models cite the same EUR 33-37bn target reported from the 27 Nov CMD.

results.note: INSEE Informations rapides no. 295 of 27 Nov 2026 (IPC résultats provisoires, novembre 2026) puts the CPI year on year at +2.9% in November after +3.4% in October.

second_opinion.note: Both models give 2.9%, the same figure as the INSEE release.

results.note: INE's flash estimate, published 27 Nov 2026 09:00, puts the annual CPI rate for November 2026 at 4.1%, eight tenths below October's 4.9%.

second_opinion.note: Both models give 4.1%, the same figure as the INE flash release.

results.note: tn.nova.cz refused scripted reading (HTTP 403); ČTK (ceskenoviny.cz, 27 Nov 23:26) and Novinky.cz (27 Nov) both report Václav Noid Bárta won the Zpěvák category at the 27 Nov gala in Forum Karlín.

second_opinion.note: Both models report Bárta as the Zpěvák winner, matching ČTK and Novinky.
